rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/admin" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/oauth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/oauth/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/login" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/login/")
rules.description: [Syn4pseOps] Block unused administration and authentication routes

rules.expression: lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.env" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.git" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wp-admin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/phpmyadmin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/xmlrpc.php" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/server-status"
rules.description: [Syn4pseOps] Block common secret and framework probes

rules.expression: raw.http.request.uri.path contains "../" or lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%2e%2e" or lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%252e%252e"

rules.description: [Syn4pseOps] Challenge requests without a user agent
